steps.js: const i=document.querySelector("input[placeholder='Enter City or Zip']"); if(!i) throw new Error('no input'); i.focus(); i.value=''; document.execCommand('insertText',false,'{{store_zip}}'); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(x=>setTimeout(x,600)); i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',code:'Enter',keyCode:13,bubbles:true})); return 'typed'
const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>/^Select$/.test(b.innerText.trim())&&b.offsetWidth); if(b) b.click(); return b?'clicked Select':'no Select'

const d=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog],[aria-modal=true],[class*=modal i],[class*=Modal],[class*=drawer i],[class*=flyout i],[class*=popover i]')].filter(e=>e.offsetWidth).pop(); return (d?('DLG['+(d.className||'').slice(0,60)+']: '+d.innerText.slice(0,1500)):'NODLG: '+document.body.innerText.slice(0,600))

const bs=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(b=>b.offsetWidth&&/^(Select|Shop here|Shop this store|Choose|Make my store)/i.test(b.innerText.trim())); return bs.map(b=>b.innerText.trim()+'@'+(b.closest('li,div')?.innerText||'').slice(0,80).replace(/\n/g,' / ')).slice(0,8).join(' || ')
